edge.title: Right-precondition grads by inverse input covariance before Muon
edge.summary: Newton-Muon keeps #12's Muon step but first right-multiplies every hidden gradient by the inverse of a ridge-damped EMA of its layer's input second-moment matrix E[xxᵀ], i.e. an input-side (K-FAC-like) whitening applied before momentum and Newton–Schulz. The statistics are collected by forward hooks on one training step in 64, and on that same step the stats are all-reduced, folded into the EMA and inverted by batched Cholesky; between refreshes the cached inverse is reused every step. Hidden lr/wd are split per family (q/k/v 0.020, attn.proj 0.025, MLP 0.030; mlp.fc wd 0.0375) and train_steps drops 3350→3300, claimed at 3275.

changes.label: Input-covariance stats via hooks
changes.detail: On steps with (step+1) % 64 == 0, forward hooks on attn.q (shared by q/k/v), attn.proj, mlp.fc and mlp.proj add xᵀx/N per microbatch to non-persistent fp32 buffers; mlp.proj's 3072-d input uses a 4-block diagonal (4×768×768) approximation.

changes.label: Cholesky refresh every 64 steps
changes.detail: _refresh_preconditioner all-reduces stats and counts, averages them, EMAs into cov (lerp 0.05, init 0.001·I), adds a ridge 0.2·mean(diag)+1e-8 and computes inv by batched cholesky_ex + cholesky_inverse, then zeroes the accumulators.

changes.label: G ← G·inv before Muon momentum
changes.detail: _precondition_grads (from the first refresh at step 63 onward, every step) right-multiplies each hidden grad by its layer's inverse (block-wise bmm for mlp.proj), then muon_update/WD run unchanged.

changes.label: Per-family lr / wd groups
changes.detail: Single group lr 0.035 / wd 0.025 becomes q/k/v 0.020/0.025, attn.proj 0.025/0.025, mlp.fc 0.030/0.0375, mlp.proj 0.030/0.025.

changes.label: train_steps 3350 → 3300, claim 3275
changes.detail: Same 25-step validation after 90%; 3275 is reached 25 steps before the LR hits 0.

changes.label: Muon accepts param-group dicts
changes.detail: Constructor sorts params inside dict groups, state init checks 'momentum' (state also holds 'precond'), and a global_step counter is synced from the training loop.

edge.parent_check: consistent — nearest-code is #12; all of #12's Muon, aux AdamW, init and validation cadence are kept, with the preconditioner and per-family groups added.
edge.noise: Docstring filename change, Muon constructor accepting dict groups, 'momentum' not in state check, global_step bookkeeping.

mechanisms.name: Newton-Muon (activation-covariance right preconditioning)
mechanisms.explain: Forward hooks, attached only on steps with (step+1)%64==0, add xᵀx/N of each layer's input to a buffer: one 768×768 matrix shared by q/k/v, one each for the attn.proj and mlp.fc inputs, and a 4-block diagonal approximation for mlp.proj's 3072-d input. On those steps the optimizer all-reduces and averages the stats, lerps them into an EMA covariance (weight 0.05, init 0.001·I) and inverts cov + (0.2·tr(cov)/d + 1e-8)·I with batched Cholesky. Every step after the first refresh, each hidden gradient G (out×in) is replaced by G·inv before Muon's momentum, Newton–Schulz and decoupled WD, so the orthogonalized step is taken in input-whitened coordinates.

caveats: Possible no-op in the logged runs (not verified by running): the hooks are registered on submodules of a model already compiled with model.compile() and run before step 63, and PyTorch's default torch._dynamo.config.skip_nnmodule_hook_guards=True means hooks added after compilation are not executed by the compiled graph. If so, count stays 0, the EMA weight is 0, cov stays 0.001·I and inv is a uniform ≈833·I — plain Muon with the per-family lr/wd retune plus a near momentum reset at step 63 (grads jump ~833×). Independently, steps 0–62 use no preconditioner, every rank preconditions every hidden grad (redundant compute), and the intended identity fallback for a failed Cholesky writes into a masked copy (K[info != 0]) so it has no effect (failures are unlikely given the 0.2·mean-diag ridge).
